lines.en: label toukacamp1:
scene black
I haven’t had much time to think about her lately, but...
lines.zh: 最近我没什么工夫去想她，不过……

lines.en: Now that I have Touka’s number, I’m sure she wouldn’t mind if I gave her a call. Right?
lines.zh: 既然我有了 Touka 的电话，我敢打给她她也不会介意吧？对吧？

lines.en: I know it’s late...and I know I may have ghosted her for months while I was lying in bed mostly unconscious. But things are better now. Kind of.
lines.zh: 我知道很晚了……也知道我之前卧床昏迷、把她晾了好几个月。但现在好些了。算是吧。

lines.en: And I think that, with her, they can get even better than that.
lines.zh: 而且我觉得，对她，事情还能比「好些」更好。

lines.en: Or maybe that’s just wishful thinking and my voice will do naught but annoy her now that she isn’t used to it anymore.
lines.zh: 又或者那只是我一厢情愿——她已经不习惯我的声音了，我的声音只会让她烦。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall1
: Hello?
: Hey. I’d like to place an order for delivery.
lines.zh: : 嘿。我想点个外卖。

lines.en: : Apologies, I believe you may have the wrong number. This is Touka Tsukioka of the Tsukioka-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，您大概打错了。这里是月冈家的 Touka Tsukioka——

lines.en: : Just one large with pepperoni. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 就要一个大号意式辣香肠的。谢谢。

lines.en: : One large with-
lines.zh: : 一个大号——

lines.en: : Actually, add some garlic knots to that as well. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 对了，再加点蒜香结。谢谢。

lines.en: : Uh- hold on one moment. Let me find a pen.
lines.zh: : 呃——请稍等。我找支笔。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall2
: Mother- you don’t happen to be carrying a pen, do you?
lines.zh: : 母亲——您身上没碰巧带笔吧？

lines.en: : A pen? For what, dear?
lines.zh: : 笔？做什么用，亲爱的？

lines.en: : A delivery order. One large with pepperoni and garlic knots.
lines.zh: : 记个外卖单。一个大号意式辣香肠加蒜香结。

lines.en: : A large {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 大号{i}什么？{/i}

lines.en: : I’m not sure. Let me confirm.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。我确认一下。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall3
: Sir, are you still there? A large {i}what,{/i} exactly?
lines.zh: : 先生，您还在吗？到底是大号{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Touka, it’s me.
lines.zh: : Touka，是我。

lines.en: : Oh, apologies again. I’ve yet to take down your name. Please wait one moment while my manager obtains something for me to write with.
lines.zh: : 哦，再次抱歉。我还没记下您的名字。请稍等，我的「经理」正去拿笔。

lines.en: : Touka, I’m not actually placing a delivery order. I’m fucking with you.
lines.zh: : Touka，我不是真要点外卖。我在耍你玩。

lines.en: : Fucking?
: One large fucking with pepperoni and garlic knots. I’ll inform the kitchen staff right away.
lines.zh: : 一份大号「耍」，配意式辣香肠和蒜香结。我这就通知厨房 staff。

lines.en: : Your order will be ready in thirty to forty-five minutes, sir.
lines.zh: : 您的订单三十到四十五分钟后好，先生。

lines.en: : Got it. Thanks again, Tina.
lines.zh: : 收到。再次感谢，Tina。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall4
: Nevermind, Mother. It’s just Sensei. I can tell by his failure to correctly say my name.
lines.zh: : 没事了，母亲。只是 Sensei。他连我名字都念不对，一听就是他。

lines.en: : Hey, I tried. But you probably didn’t recognize my voice {i}because{/i} I was using the correct name.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我试过好好念的。但你没认出我的声音，多半就是{i}因为{/i}我念对了名字。

lines.en: : What does Sensei want with a large pepperoni fucking?
lines.zh: : Sensei 要一份大号「意式辣香肠耍」干嘛？

lines.en: : Are the delivery parlors near his home-
lines.zh: : 他家附近的外卖店——

lines.en: scene toukacampcall5
: Oh! This must be one of those “crank calls” I have heard about on the television. He wasn’t actually ordering anything at all, was he?
lines.zh: : 哦！这一定就是我在电视上听说过的那种「恶作剧电话」。他根本不是真要点东西，对吧？

lines.en: : Do you think I have time for your games, Sensei? I’d have gladly answered if your intention was not to toy with my emotions and consume precious business hours.
lines.zh: : 你以为我有空陪你玩吗，Sensei？你要不是想玩弄我的感情、浪费我宝贵的办公时间，我早就接了。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall1
: My bad. I’ve once again underestimated just how out of the loop you and your mother are.
lines.zh: : 怪我。我又一次低估了你和你母亲有多「脱节」。

lines.en: : Yes, well, there are plenty of loops we’re involved in that you could never even {i}hope{/i} to come into contact with. So what do you {i}really{/i} want? There isn’t a problem with your apartment, is there?
lines.zh: : 是，我们确实参与了很多你永远{i}别想{/i}接触到的「圈子」。那么你{i}到底{/i}想要什么？你的公寓没出什么问题吧？

lines.en: : No. I’m actually in the woods right now.
lines.zh: : 没有。我现在其实在树林里。

lines.en: : The...woods? Are you in trouble? Do you need me to send someone to-
lines.zh: : 树……树林？你遇上麻烦了？要我派个人去——

lines.en: : I’m just camping.
lines.zh: : 我只是在露营。

lines.en: : Camping?
lines.zh: : 露营？

lines.en: : It’s when you go hang out in the woods and then ultimately go to sleep there.
lines.zh: : 就是跑到树林里待着，最后还在那儿睡觉。

lines.en: : One moment, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 稍等，Sensei。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall6
: Mother, have you heard of something called “camping” before?
lines.zh: : 母亲，您听说过一种叫「露营」的东西吗？

lines.en: : Why, yes. I believe that’s when a group of commoners go into a wooded area with the intention of creating some form of recreational shelter and...starting fires?
lines.zh: : 嗯，听过。我想那是一群平民跑到树林里去，搭个某种「娱乐性栖身所」，还……生火？

lines.en: : Why would they do such a thing?
lines.zh: : 他们干嘛要那样？

lines.en: : I’m not sure, dear. The poor do all sorts of strange things, but we mustn’t question their customs for that could be one of us one day.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，亲爱的。穷人什么怪事都干得出来，但我们不该质疑他们的习俗——因为说不定哪天我们也有份。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall7
: Sensei? Are you still there?
lines.zh: : Sensei？你还在吗？

lines.en: scene toukacampcall8
: Yes. And I heard all of that.
lines.zh: : 在。而且那些我全听见了。

lines.en: : Oh, splendid. Then, would you mind explaining to me why you’d willingly do something like “camping?” Are you that desperate to get away from everyone that you’d isolate yourself in the woods?
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。那你介意解释一下，你干嘛要自愿干「露营」这种事吗？你就这么想躲开所有人，宁可把自己隔离在树林里？

lines.en: : I’m not isolating myself. I’m here with Ami and some of my other friends.
lines.zh: : 我没隔离自己。我跟 Ami 还有我其他几个朋友在这儿。

lines.en: : Since when do you have friends?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候有朋友的？

lines.en: : I don’t know. They’ve just kind of always been around. But it doesn’t really matter {i}why{/i} I’m out here. What matters is that I wanted to talk to you.
lines.zh: : 不知道。他们就是一直在我身边。不过我{i}干嘛{/i}来这儿不重要。重要的是我想跟你说话。

lines.en: : About what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体说什么？

lines.en: scene toukacampcall9
: Does there actually need to be a reason?
lines.zh: : 非得有个理由吗？

lines.en: : Because I don’t have one.
lines.zh: : 因为我没有。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall10
: I kind of just wanted to hear your voice.
lines.zh: : 我有点想听听你的声音。

lines.en: : You...
scene toukacampcall11
: You’re only saying that to get a rise out of me...just like when you ordered the pepperoni fucking.
lines.zh: : 你说这话只是想让我失态……就跟你点那份「意式辣香肠耍」一样。

lines.en: : Maybe I am, maybe I’m not. Can you talk or not, though? Because I was kind of hoping we could maybe do this {i}without{/i} Tsubasa looming over your shoulder.
lines.zh: : 也许是，也许不是。不过你到底能不能聊？因为我本来希望咱俩能聊，而{i}不用{/i} Tsubasa 在你背后盯着。

lines.en: : Regardless of the reason, you’ve chosen a terrible time to do this. I’m in the middle of-
lines.zh: : 不管什么理由，你挑的时机都糟透了。我正在——

lines.en: scene toukacampcall12
: Wow, I sure am tired all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 哇，我突然好累啊。

lines.en: : Uhh...please hold again, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 呃……请再稍等，Sensei。

lines.en: : Mother, weren’t you just saying a moment ago how much energy you’ve had as of late?
lines.zh: : 母亲，您刚才不还说最近精力特别充沛吗？

lines.en: scene toukacampcall13
: Yes. But I must have forgotten to mention how today is the exception to that.
lines.zh: : 是。可我忘了提，今天是个例外。

lines.en: : So, if you’d please excuse me, I believe it’s time that I retire for the evening.
lines.zh: : 那么，请恕我失陪，我想我该就寝了。

lines.en: : If...that is what you believe to be best, then-
lines.zh: : 如果……您觉得这样最好，那就——

lines.en: scene toukacampcall14
: Goodnight, dear. And please don’t stay up too late. We have guests coming in the morning that we must be prepared for.
lines.zh: : 晚安，亲爱的。请别熬太晚。早上有客人来，我们得做好准备。

lines.en: : Y...Yes, Mother. I understand.
lines.zh: : 好……好的，母亲。我明白。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall1
: Sensei? Are you still there?
lines.zh: : Sensei？你还在吗？

lines.en: : Yes. And again, I heard all of that. Phones pick up a lot now, Touka.
lines.zh: : 在。而且，那些我又全听见了。现在的手机收音可灵了，Touka。

lines.en: : Then...I suppose it appears that I {i}do{/i} have time to talk after all. But I’m still not quite sure of what’s going on here.
lines.zh: : 那……看来我终究{i}还是{/i}有空聊了。可我还是不太明白这是怎么一回事。

lines.en: : From what I understand, one does not typically call another {i}just{/i} to hear their voice.
lines.zh: : 据我所知，一个人一般不会{i}只{/i}为了「听听对方的声音」就打给另一个人。

lines.en: : People in relationships do.
lines.zh: : 有关系的人会。

lines.en: : But the two of us do not have the sort of “relationship” you’re referring to at the moment.
lines.zh: : 可我们俩眼下并没有你所说的那种「关系」。

lines.en: : But we {i}do{/i} have {i}a{/i} relationship.
lines.zh: : 但我们{i}确实{/i}有关系。

lines.en: : If you want to be that vague, I have a relationship with {i}many{/i} people.
lines.zh: : 你要说得这么含糊，那我跟{i}很多{/i}人都有「关系」。

lines.en: : Sure. But do you feel the same way when you’re talking to me that you feel with any of them?
lines.zh: : 当然。可你跟我说话时的感觉，跟跟他们说话时一样吗？

lines.en: : Are you referring to the innate desire to reach through the telephone and smack the side of your head?
lines.zh: : 你是指那种「想隔着电话扇你一巴掌」的本能冲动？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m pretty sure they call that “love” in some cultures.
lines.zh: : 对。我敢肯定有些文化管那叫「爱」。

lines.en: : Hah...what have I gotten myself into now?
lines.zh: : 哈……我这又是把自己卷进什么事里了？

lines.en: scene black
I remain on the phone with Touka as she walks through the halls of the manor. And, throughout that time, I fill her in on why I’m out here and what I hope to accomplish with Ami.
lines.zh: Touka 穿过大宅走廊时，我一直跟她通着电话。这段时间里，我把我为什么在这儿、以及我希望跟 Ami 达成什么，都告诉了她。

lines.en: Or I guess...what I’ve {i}already{/i} somehow accomplished.
lines.zh: 或者说……我不知怎么{i}已经{/i}达成的东西。

lines.en: It feels weird to share any of this with one of her classmates, though. Even if I barely look at Touka as another teenager in the first place when she acts so much more mature than the rest of them.
lines.zh: 不过，跟她的一个同班同学分享这些，感觉有点怪。尽管 Touka 表现得比她们成熟太多，我打一开始就没把她当成又一个十几岁的孩子。

lines.en: And yes, I know that sort of statement makes me sound deplorable and that it would never hold up in a court of law, but I mean it.
lines.zh: 而且，对，我知道这种话听着有多不堪、在法庭上也绝对站不住脚，但我是认真的。

lines.en: I wouldn’t see her as some sort of matriarch if I was getting high off of her hormones. And I certainly wouldn’t be calling her in the middle of the night just to “talk.”
lines.zh: 我要是被她的荷尔蒙冲昏了头，就不会把她当什么「女家长」看了。也肯定不会深更半夜只为「聊聊」就打给她。

lines.en: But the fact of the matter {i}is{/i} that I just wanted to hear her voice. And another fact of the matter is that I know she wanted to hear mine.
lines.zh: 可事实{i}就是{/i}，我只是想听听她的声音。而另一个事实是，我知道她也想听我的。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall15
But those ways do not run parallel with one another.
lines.zh: 但这两条「路」并不平行。

lines.en: They violently intersect, slicing each other in half, and all we can do is wait to feel the after-effects and hope that most of our limbs remain intact.
lines.zh: 它们猛烈地相交、把彼此劈成两半，而我们能做的，只有等着感受那余波、祈祷大半的「肢体」还能完好。

lines.en: For right now, this is perfect.
lines.zh: 眼下，这样就很好。

lines.en: But I know it can’t stay this way forever.
lines.zh: 可我知道，不会永远这样下去。

lines.en: : You’re on speaker, Sensei. So please do me a favor and keep the inappropriate language to a minimum. You never know just who is listening around here.
lines.zh: : 你开的是免提，Sensei。所以请帮我个忙，把不正经的话压到最少。你永远不知道这附近谁在听。

lines.en: : You and your mother were literally just talking about “pepperoni fucking” like ten minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 你和你母亲十分钟前还在聊「意式辣香肠耍」呢。

lines.en: : Yes, but that was when I was under the impression that “fucking” was simply a slang term for a food item I’d never heard before.
lines.zh: : 是，可那会儿我以为「耍」只是某种我没听过的食物的俚语。

lines.en: : You must remember that there’s a great deal I still don’t understand about your world, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你得记住，Sensei，我对你们那个世界还有太多不懂。

lines.en: : Oh, I don’t need to remember. You remind me every time I talk to you.
lines.zh: : 哦，我不需要「记住」。你每次跟我说话都在提醒我。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall16
: Then you most assuredly {i}do{/i} require a reminder as you had no qualms at all with completely ignoring me for several months.
lines.zh: : 那你{i}绝对{/i}更需要被提醒——因为你毫不顾忌地把我晾了好几个月。

lines.en: : I completely ignored {i}everyone{/i} for several months, Touka.
lines.zh: : 我好几个月晾的是{i}所有人{/i}，Touka。

lines.en: : Yes. But you and I have a {i}relationship,{/i} don’t we?
lines.zh: : 是。但你和我之间有「{i}关系{/i}」，不是吗？

lines.en: : Isn’t that what you said just a short while ago, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 这话不是你刚才自己说的吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I mean...yeah.
lines.zh: : 我是说……是。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall17
: So that {i}relationship{/i} only exists when it benefits you?
lines.zh: : 所以那段「{i}关系{/i}」只在对你有利时才存在？

lines.en: : That’s not what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Then please explain what you mean a little better. Because your earlier words implied that there was some sort of connection between us and {i}now{/i} you’re making it sound like I’m no different from anyone at all.
lines.zh: : 那请你说得更明白点。因为你先前的话暗示我们俩之间有某种「联结」，可{i}现在{/i}你又说得好像我跟别人毫无分别。

lines.en: : Which one is it, Sensei? Do tell.
lines.zh: : 到底是哪个，Sensei？说清楚。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for ignoring you, Touka.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Touka，我不该晾着你。

lines.en: : As you should be. I’m disappointed in you.
lines.zh: : 你确实该道歉。我对你很失望。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall18
: Don’t think I didn’t notice how frequently your eyes landed on me at the Halloween party, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 别以为我没注意到，万圣节派对上你的目光往我身上瞟了多少次，Sensei。

lines.en: : You mean the one where I literally sought you out and asked you to stay with me? Because yeah, that would typically involve a certain amount of eye contact.
lines.zh: : 你说的是那场「我特地找到你、还请你陪着我」的派对？因为那种事本来就得有一定程度的眼神接触。

lines.en: : And what? You just...stopped desiring such a thing once that night came to an end? Did you think for a moment about how that would make {i}me{/i} feel?
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？那晚一结束，你就……不再想要那种事了？你有一瞬想过那会让{i}我{/i}是什么感受吗？

lines.en: scene toukacampcall19
: If one second I’m important to you and the next I’m not, how is that any different than the more {i}playful{/i} ways in which you tug at my strings, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 前一秒我对你还很重要，后一秒又不是了——这跟你那些{i}玩弄{/i}我「线」的把戏，有什么分别，Sensei？

lines.en: : It’s starting to sound like I’m in trouble right now.
lines.zh: : 听着怎么像我惹上麻烦了。

lines.en: : Because you are. But I’m kind enough to not make you grovel at my feet and beg for forgiveness.
lines.zh: : 因为你确实惹上了。不过我够仁慈，不会让你跪在我脚下求原谅。

lines.en: : Then tell me, kind and wonderful Touka, what must I do to be forgiven?
lines.zh: : 那告诉我，仁慈又了不起的 Touka，我要怎么做才能得到原谅？

lines.en: scene toukacampcall1
: Simply doing what I ask you to do means nothing to me when I have the power to {i}make{/i} you do anything I want, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我有本事{i}让{/i}你做任何事，Sensei，所以「照我说的做」对我毫无意义。

lines.en: : Your mother would be so proud right now.
lines.zh: : 你母亲此刻一定非常骄傲。

lines.en: : If you truly want to mend the wound that {i}you{/i} have inflicted upon us, {i}you{/i} will come up with a solution. I will not coddle you 100%% of the way.
lines.zh: : 你要真想弥补{i}你{/i}给我们造成的伤口，就得{i}自己{/i}想出个办法来。我可不会全程手把手惯着你。

lines.en: : How about 90%%?
lines.zh: : 那 90% 惯着行不行？

lines.en: : That sounds much more manageable. I accept.
lines.zh: : 那听着可行多了。我接受。

lines.en: : But I hope you understand that this means {i}you{/i} will be putting in a certain amount of work as well.
lines.zh: : 但我希望你明白，这意味着你{i}自己{/i}也得出一部分力。

lines.en: : I think I can probably manage 10%%.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 10% 我大概应付得来。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall20
: I would sure hope so. I can only imagine how destined to fail this {i}relationship{/i} would be if {i}both{/i} of us were incapable of acting our age.
lines.zh: : 但愿如此。要是我们{i}俩{/i}都不懂事，我真不敢想象这段{i}关系{/i}注定要失败成什么样。

lines.en: : You’re probably even further off than I am, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，你比我还不懂事。

lines.en: : Yes, because I’m a mature and responsible young woman while {i}you’re{/i} a blubbering lunatic who wastes his precious phone time on a girl half his age.
lines.zh: : 对，因为我是个成熟负责的年轻女性，而{i}你{/i}是个哭哭啼啼的疯子，把宝贵的通话时间浪费在一个年纪只有你一半的女孩身上。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall1
: That’s me alright.
lines.zh: : 没错，这就是我。

lines.en: : I’m glad you called, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你打来了，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m always happy to hear your voice.
lines.zh: : 我总是很乐意听你的声音。

lines.en: : Even {i}when{/i} it torments me.
lines.zh: : {i}哪怕{/i}它在折磨我。

lines.en: : I’m not tormenting you right now, am I?
lines.zh: : 我现在没在折磨你吧？

lines.en: : You most certainly are- forcing me to have a conversation this intimate over the telephone rather than appearing before me in person.
lines.zh: : 你分明就在折磨我——逼我用电话进行这么亲密的谈话，而不是亲自出现在我面前。

lines.en: : Is “intimate” the right word here?
lines.zh: : 「亲密」用在这儿合适吗？

lines.en: : Are we not privately sharing our feelings with one another? Is that not what intimacy is?
lines.zh: : 我们此刻不正在私下分享彼此的感受吗？那不就是「亲密」吗？

lines.en: : I just typically associate that word with something else.
lines.zh: : 我一般把那个词跟别的东西联系在一起。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall21
: That’s because {i}you’re{/i} a bastard and {i}I’m{/i} a princess.
lines.zh: : 那是因为{i}你{/i}是个混蛋，而{i}我{/i}是个公主。

lines.en: : At least half of that statement is correct.
lines.zh: : 这话至少有一半说对了。

lines.en: : Which half?
lines.zh: : 哪一半？

lines.en: : The former, obviously. Being a princess requires a little more than just being rich.
lines.zh: : 显然是前半。当公主需要的可不只是有钱。

lines.en: : There you go again, squandering a perfect opportunity to mend the wound you’ve inflicted by pouring salt in it.
lines.zh: : 你又来了——白白糟蹋一个弥补你造成的伤口的好机会，偏要往伤口上撒盐。

lines.en: : I formally apologize for knowing the textbook definition of “princess.”
lines.zh: : 我为「知道『公主』的教科书定义」一事，正式道歉。

lines.en: : Apology accepted. Now, apologize for setting my mind ablaze during your two month absence.
lines.zh: : 道歉接受。现在，再为「你消失两个月让我心焦如焚」道歉。

lines.en: : Ablaze? You thought about me that much?
lines.zh: : 心焦如焚？你有那么想我？

lines.en: scene toukacampcall22
: Considering the last look I had at you was met with a glance that screamed “save me,” yes. I thought about you quite a bit.
lines.zh: : 考虑到我最后看你那一眼，换来的是一副写着「救救我」的眼神——是的。我想你想得相当多。

lines.en: : I worried almost constantly. But I was also furious with you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我几乎一直在担心。可同时我又很生你的气，Sensei。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall9
: Which is ultimately why I elected to not save you at all when all it would have taken was one phone call.
lines.zh: : 所以到头来，尽管只需一个电话，我还是决定干脆不救你。

lines.en: : So...maybe I {i}do{/i} want to see you grovel. Just a little bit.
lines.zh: : 所以……也许我{i}确实{/i}想看你低声下气。就一点点。

lines.en: : I’ll make sure to do that the next time I see you.
lines.zh: : 下次见你时我一定补上。

lines.en: : And when will that be?
lines.zh: : 那是什么时候？

lines.en: : When do you want it to be?
lines.zh: : 你想什么时候？

lines.en: : I want you to start living up to that 10%% and make your {i}own{/i} decisions about what to do with me rather than letting me guide you the whole way. Did I not make that clear enough?
lines.zh: : 我希望你开始兑现你那「10%」，{i}自己{/i}拿主意「要拿我怎么办」，而不是全程让我引导你。我说得还不够清楚吗？

lines.en: : I can promise you that you do {i}not{/i} want me making the decisions about “what to do with you.”
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，你绝对{i}不{/i}想让我来决定「要拿你怎么办」。

lines.en: : Are you being a bastard again? Insinuating such impure things to a lady of my stature?
lines.zh: : 你又耍混蛋了？对我这种身份的小姐暗示那么下流的事？

lines.en: : I’m pretty much always being a bastard. I thought you knew that about me.
lines.zh: : 我基本一直都在耍混蛋。我以为你了解我这点。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall23
: Oh, I do. It’s actually rather pathetic.
lines.zh: : 哦，我了解。这其实挺可悲的。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m well aware.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我很清楚。

lines.en: : Are you?
lines.zh: : 你清楚？

lines.en: : Yeah. But I’ll make it up to you soon. Does Saturday morning sound okay?
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过我很快会补偿你。周六上午行吗？

lines.en: : Okay for what? You haven’t even informed me of what we’ll be doing yet.
lines.zh: : 行什么？你都还没告诉我我们要干嘛。

lines.en: : I’ll just take you out to eat or something and we can talk more about how much I suck for letting you wallow in worry for several months.
lines.zh: : 我带你出去吃点东西什么的，再多聊聊我让你白白担心好几个月这事有多混蛋。

lines.en: : Sounds wonderful. I’ll mark my calendar in anticipation of your expected groveling.
lines.zh: : 听着不错。我会在日历上标记好，期待你的「赔罪」。

lines.en: : There will be no groveling involved. Just food and likely depressing dialogue.
lines.zh: : 没有什么赔罪。只有吃的，外加多半很丧的对话。

lines.en: : Oh, then why don’t I just cancel now? {i}Anyone{/i} can buy me food, Sensei. Such a thing won’t show me you care.
lines.zh: : 哦，那我现在干脆取消得了？{i}谁{/i}都能给我买吃的，Sensei。那样可没法让我看到你在乎我。

lines.en: : So until you start expressing with both your actions {i}and{/i} words that you regret the way you’ve treated me, I simply won’t believe you.
lines.zh: : 所以，在你开始用行动{i}和{/i}言语双双表明「你为那样对我感到后悔」之前，我就是不信你。

lines.en: : You like the way I treat you, though.
lines.zh: : 可你喜欢我那样对你。

lines.en: : When it’s just teasing...I suppose I do. But this time was different.
lines.zh: : 只是逗逗我的话……我想我确实是喜欢。但这次不一样。

lines.en: : This time, you really hurt me.
lines.zh: : 这次，你是真的伤到我了。

lines.en: scene toukacampcall24
: So I want you...to make up for it...
lines.zh: : 所以我要你……补偿我……

lines.en: scene toukacampcall1
: I guess I’ll practice my dogeza then.
lines.zh: : 那我去练练「土下座」好了。

lines.en: : Mm...I’m excited to see it...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我很期待看到……

lines.en: : So...Saturday works then?
lines.zh: : 那……周六就这么定了？

lines.en: : Cool.
: Are you still there?
lines.zh: : 你还在吗？

lines.en: : Are you tired or something? You sound different.
lines.zh: : 你是累了还是怎么？声音听着不一样了。

lines.en: : Yes...it’s been a long day...
lines.zh: : 嗯……今天太累了……

lines.en: : But you’ve made it a lot better by calling.
lines.zh: : 不过你打来，让它好多了。

lines.en: : Should I just hang up and...let you sleep then?
lines.zh: : 要不我挂了……让你睡觉？

lines.en: scene black
: Stay on the line a little longer.
lines.zh: : 再多陪我聊一会儿。

lines.en: Touka falls silent several minutes later and I’m left with nothing to do but...continue aimlessly wandering through the woods.
lines.zh: 几分钟后 Touka 没了声响，我没事可做，只好……继续在树林里漫无目的地走。

lines.en: I’m not sure what she expects me to do come Saturday, but...
lines.zh: 我不确定她周六指望我干什么，但……

lines.en: I can almost guarantee it won’t be what she wants.
lines.zh: 我几乎能保证，那不会是她想要的。

lines.en: All I can do is just hope it won’t stretch the wound out even further.
lines.zh: 我能做的，只有祈祷它不会把那道伤口扯得更大。

lines.en: I want to keep her close.
lines.zh: 我想把她留在身边。

lines.en: Just as a different sort of tool than I’m used to.
lines.zh: 只是把她当作一种我还不习惯的、不同的「工具」。

$ toukacamp1 = True
{i}Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Touka 的好感度上升到了 [touka_love]！{/i}

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
Now what?
lines.zh: 现在干嘛？
